thought.text: All 28 backend services' main modules import successfully (25 immediately; the 3 that require runtime config import cleanly once their documented env vars are supplied — proving the packages are correctly installed). Now let me verify the frontend image serves content and check the sub-MFE images:

reasoning_content:
All 28 backend services can now be successfully imported (25 of them work as-is, and 3 of them import without any issues once you supply the necessary environment variables for execution as described in the guide). This conclusively proves that all the dependencies are correctly installed in all the images.

Next, let's verify the frontend: that the dist output exists and that the nginx image can be served. Let's check whether the frontend image is serving content, and check the dist output for each MFE.

action.command:
echo "== frontend nginx dist contents:"
docker run --rm --entrypoint sh frontend -c 'ls /usr/share/nginx/html/ && echo --- && ls /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-fp/ 2>/dev/null | head && echo --- && ls /usr/share/nginx/html/mfe-ewm-injector/ 2>/dev/null | head'
echo ""
echo "== frontend serves index.html on :8080:"
cid=$(docker run -d -p 8188:8080 frontend); sleep 4
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8188/ 2>&1
curl -s http://localhost:8188/ 2>&1 | head -8
docker rm -f $cid >/dev/null 2>&1
